contracts: Maintainer-authorized input repair at 9cd87d3a; no VDD rerun, Bootstrap or new governance receipt. Existing compiler/terminal/history files are historical, not current execution proof.
Use current Quick Dev controlled probes: present -> regression; missing -> causal RED/GREEN/REFACTOR; mixed -> retain both subsets; unverifiable -> repair harness/environment, never manufacture RED.

The primary selector is Python -m pytest for current CER collection. Q2 authors one pytest case per atomic obligation, marking each required assertion with pytest.mark.cer_assertion. Keep parameter instances individually attributable.

For C# behavior, the pytest case must invoke the real named .NET boundary test with a literal subprocess.run argv list, explicit shell=False, dotnet test PhaseA.Platform.Tests/PhaseA.Platform.Tests.csproj, exact --filter FullyQualifiedName=<mapped case> and --logger trx. The frozen C# Fact/Theory source must call a declared real owner (or WebApplicationFactory<Program> plus CreateClient); its test project must reference the owner project. Then parse a fresh per-invocation TRX, verify the expected case identity and all required parameter results, then assert the actual product observation. A build/discovery/timeout/privilege/setup failure raises a harness error, never an AssertionError labeled as product RED. No skip, xfail, constants, source-text checks or stale TRX as substitute.

Failure IDs belong only to failing bound behavioral assertions. Freeze wrapper, C# case, helpers, fixture and case map before formal RED; GREEN/REFACTOR reuse them byte-for-byte. Include all authored test dependencies in execution_snapshot_paths before freezing; do not edit the plan during GREEN.

Only declared production owners may change after expected RED. Program.cs changes are narrow endpoint/composition changes, never whole-file restructuring. Respect applicable existing protected-path authority; do not widen live/runtime access.

No live metadata/workspace, runtime/Caddy, shared Skill, Taskmaster, model/backend authority or historical evidence writes. Use disposable roots and SQLite; retain failed diagnostics under the explicitly owned logs directory.

Current host/OS/fixture capabilities are checked locally. Real restricted Windows processes, Job Object lifetime, NTFS denial, SQLite restart, authenticated routes and publication must not be mocked. Harmless workloads may isolate unrelated model behavior.

Preserve every bound assertion in the terminal proof. Positive result fields must correspond to actual successful checks; count/exit-code/record existence alone is insufficient. Optional regrouping is not a prerequisite.
All bound assertions have current non-skipped CER cases proving their real boundary outcomes; planned test names, markers, counts, records and historical results alone cannot satisfy closure.
recovery: Preserve diagnostics; fix only the identified harness or product boundary; re-probe this slice and affected dependents. Never roll back correct behavior for RED.
